name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods: agent dashboard, auto handover, build output trimmer, auto compact, prompt upgrade, keep-going, a searchable memory database, plus cache-tax and reflect-mod

plugins.name: agent-dashboard
plugins.description: One Dashboard pane with usage and context bars, the task list, test runs, running sessions and subagents (/dashboard)

plugins.name: auto-handover
plugins.description: /handover writes a handover note and starts (or proposes) a fresh session that continues from it

plugins.name: build-trimmer
plugins.description: Trims long xcodebuild and swift build/test output to the errors and summary, keeping the full log on disk

plugins.name: prompt-upgrade
plugins.description: /improve rewrites a rough prompt into a clear, specific one for review

plugins.name: memdb
plugins.description: A searchable memory database for Claude: search/add/get/index tools, a /memdb command, memory files indexed automatically

plugins.name: auto-compact
plugins.description: Compacts past 250k tokens and saves the full transcript to ~/.claude/compact-saves before every compaction (/autocompact)

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks (/keepwarm) and stops a cold send once with its rewrite cost (/cache-tax). By Karan Bansal, MIT; patched here

plugins.name: reflect-mod
plugins.description: Spots reusable corrections in your prompts and saves them to CLAUDE.md on one press. By Bayram Annakov (claude-reflect), MIT

plugins.name: keep-going
plugins.description: Stops Claude ending a turn on a vague "want me to…?": it keeps working or asks with clickable options
